title: course.json
description: Describes one course to the shared course shell. The checks that decide whether a course may ship are in scripts/course-config.mjs; this schema gives editors autocomplete and inline help.

id.description: The repository name. It names the saved progress (browser storage keys and the learner's cloud document), so never change it once the course is live.

tracks.description: Tracks in order for guided format.

subject.description: What is being taught, as it reads inside a sentence, e.g. "Angular". Used in "areas of Angular" and "Angular 17+".

description.description: One sentence for search engines and link previews.

color.description: The brand colour. On its own it is enough: the shades, gradient, logo and favicon are derived from it.

scale.description: Optional exact shades, lightest (50) to darkest (950); 600 is the main colour.

gradient.description: Optional three stops for the logo and the highlighted headline words.

gradientDark.description: Optional lighter stops for dark mode. Defaults to "gradient".

logo.description: Optional path to an SVG in the course folder, e.g. "assets/logo.svg". Without it the shell draws its bite mark in the brand gradient.

favicon.description: Optional path to an .ico, .svg or .png in the course folder. Without it the bite mark is used.

home.description: Home page copy. Every part is optional.

badge.description: A short announcement above the headline.

headline.description: Text before, the highlighted words, text after. Defaults to "Learn <subject> one five-minute bite at a time."

searchExamples.description: Words suggested in the search box.

featuredLesson.description: Slug of the bite on the hero card. Defaults to the first bite, A to Z.

featuredCode.description: A code sample of at most 8 lines shown on the hero card.

quizPreview.description: The picture of a quiz question next to the quiz teaser.

selected.description: Position of the option drawn as chosen, counting from 0.

kinds.description: The kinds a lesson can be (front-matter "kind"). Defaults to concept, api, technique, pattern, pitfall, tool.

hint.description: One line shown with the kind filter.

codeLanguages.description: Prism language names that code blocks may use, e.g. ["python", "bash"]. Leave empty for a course without code; lessons then need no code block.
